description: This file declares functions related to managing network bridges, such as initialization, shutdown, and iteration over ports and bridges. It provides platform-specific inline implementations for non-Linux systems.

methods.name: int br_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes network bridge subsystem; implementation varies by platform.

methods.name: void br_shutdown(void)
methods.description: Shuts down network bridge subsystem; implementation varies by platform.

methods.name: int br_foreach_port(const char * brname,int (* iterator)(const char * br,const char * port,void * arg),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over ports of a specified bridge, calling a callback for each port; default implementation returns 0.

methods.name: int br_foreach_bridge(int (* iterator)(const char *,void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over all bridges, calling a callback for each bridge; default implementation returns 0.

ctags.name: br_foreach_port
ctags.signature: (const char * brname,int (* iterator)(const char * br,const char * port,void * arg),void * arg)
